1809: Red silk sheets and a mirror on the ceiling. Vance isn't here for that.
1811: Flip-flops in every color, stacked to the ceiling. Slogan: "Everyone wears them. Now with non-slip soles for acid rain."
1813: Curvy chilled bottles glowing red. Slogan: "Open happiness. Now with zero sugar and one hundred percent nanobots."
1815: Sandwiches assembled by a robotic arm that asks "which bread?" with infinite patience. Slogan: "Eat fresh. Fresher than Sector 4's air, at least."
1817: Lab-grown beef burgers, printed to order. Slogan: "Have it your way. The printer's way, actually."
1819: Golden neon arches and drones flying out of the roof with paper bags. Slogan: "I'm lovin' it. Delivered in 90 seconds, acid rain or shine."
1821: Open 24 hours since 1927, says the sign. The cashier is a robotic arm that says good morning to everyone. Slogan: "Oh, thank heaven. We never close, not even for the apocalypse."
1823: A white, minimalist window with neural implants displayed like jewelry. The logo is a bitten pear. Slogan: "Think Different. Think connected."
1825: Smart fridges, massaging sofas and eye implants on sale. Slogan: "Totally dedicated to you. Implants in 48 interest-free installments."
1843: A holographic siren waves from the sign. The counter AI misspells your name on the cup, on purpose, "for tradition." Slogan: "Your third place. Between home, work and the metaverse."
1847: Sneakers with magnetic cushioning and self-tying laces. Slogan on the glass: "Just Jack In."
1849: Chain pharmacy with an aisle of nano-medicines. Slogan: "Discount with your ID. Bigger discount with your DNA."
1851: Folding screens, folding watches and a salesman with folding eyes. Slogan: "Do what you can't. Fold what you can."
